title: Reporting a Lost Card
meta: B2 · 约 280 词 · 场景：电话挂失信用卡与可疑交易

lines.en: Thank you for calling Card Services. This is Michelle. How can I help?
lines.zh: 感谢致电信用卡服务中心，我是 Michelle。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: **Hi, I think I've lost my credit card. I need to block it right away.**
lines.zh: 你好，我的信用卡好像丢了。需要马上冻结。

lines.en: I can help with that. First, I need to ==verify== your identity. Could I have your full name and date of birth?
lines.zh: 我来帮您处理。首先需要核实身份。请告诉我您的全名和出生日期。

lines.en: It's Lee Wei, born on the fourth of March, nineteen eighty-eight.
lines.zh: Lee Wei，一九八八年三月四日出生。

lines.en: Thank you. I've just sent a ==one-time password== to your mobile. Could you read it out?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我刚往您手机发了一个一次性验证码，请念一下。

lines.en: Sure, it's seven, four, one, nine, zero, two.
lines.zh: 好的，是七四一九零二。

lines.en: That's verified. When did you last use the card?
lines.zh: 核实成功。您最后一次用这张卡是什么时候？

lines.en: Last night at a restaurant in Tanjong Pagar. I think I __left it behind__ there.
lines.zh: 昨晚在丹戎巴葛的一家餐厅。我估计是落在那儿了。

lines.en: Okay, I've ==blocked== the card now. Nobody can use it from this point on.
lines.zh: 好的，卡已经冻结了。从现在起没人能用这张卡。

lines.en: I do see two ==transactions== this morning, both online. Did you make those?
lines.zh: 我看到今天早上有两笔交易，都是网上的。是您本人消费的吗？

lines.en: What are they? I haven't used the card since last night.
lines.zh: 是什么交易？我从昨晚起就没用过这张卡。

lines.en: One for two hundred and forty dollars at an electronics store, and one for eighteen dollars at a food delivery app.
lines.zh: 一笔是电器店的二百四十元，一笔是外卖平台的十八元。

lines.en: **Neither of those was me. Can I dispute them?**
lines.zh: 这两笔都不是我。我能申诉吗？

lines.en: Yes. I'll __raise a dispute__ for both and flag them as ==fraud==. You won't be charged while we ==investigate==.
lines.zh: 可以。我给这两笔都提交争议，标记为盗刷。调查期间不会向您收费。

lines.en: Thank you. __How long__ does the investigation usually take?
lines.zh: 谢谢。调查一般要多久？

lines.en: Usually two to four weeks. We'll update you by email.
lines.zh: 一般两到四周，我们会邮件通知您进展。

lines.en: **And can you send me a replacement card? My phone bill is paid with this one.**
lines.zh: 能给我补一张新卡吗？我的手机话费是用这张卡扣的。

lines.en: A new card will arrive in five to seven working days, with a new number. You'll need to __update__ your recurring payments.
lines.zh: 新卡五到七个工作日寄到，卡号会变。您需要更新自动扣款的卡号。

lines.en: Got it. Could I also get a reference number for this call?
lines.zh: 明白了。能给我这次来电的参考编号吗？

lines.en: Of course. I'll send it to you by text right after this call.
lines.zh: 当然。挂电话后我马上短信发给您。

gist.q: 客服是怎么核实「你」的身份的？
gist.a: 先问全名和出生日期，再发一次性验证码让你念出来。

gist.q: 卡被冻结后发现了什么？
gist.a: 早上有两笔网上交易不是本人：电器店二百四十元、外卖平台十八元。

gist.q: 客服后续做了哪些处理？
gist.a: 两笔交易提交争议并标记盗刷，调查期间不收费；补寄新卡，提醒更新自动扣款；短信发参考编号。

prompts.q: 你在手机银行里收到一条你没做过的扣款提醒，但卡还在你手上。打电话给银行，说明情况并要求处理。
prompts.ref: Hi, I just got an alert for a charge of about ninety dollars on my credit card, but I didn't make it. The card is still with me, so I think the details might have been stolen online. Could you block this card, dispute the charge, and send me a new one? I'd also like to know if there were any other strange payments.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我刚收到信用卡一笔大约九十元的扣款提醒，但不是我刷的。卡还在我身上，所以我怀疑卡信息在网上被盗了。能帮我冻结这张卡、对这笔扣款提出争议、再寄一张新卡吗？我也想知道还有没有别的异常付款。

prompts.q: 冻结卡片后你发现卡其实在外套口袋里。打电话问能不能解冻，以及之前的争议还会不会继续处理。
prompts.ref: Hi, I called this morning to block my card, but I've just found it in my jacket pocket. Is it possible to unblock it instead of getting a replacement? Also, I reported a charge I didn't recognise. I still don't think that one was me, so I'd like the dispute to carry on. Is that okay?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我今天早上打电话冻结了卡，结果刚在外套口袋里找到了。能不能直接解冻，不用补新卡？另外我之前报了一笔不认识的扣款，我仍然觉得那笔不是我刷的，希望争议继续处理，可以吗？
